speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are? Also, have you noticed any rash or sensitivity to light?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or decreased fetal movement? I also need to know if you have had any recent travel or contact with livestock, such as sheep or goats.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture. Have you noticed any joint pain or muscle aches?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility and your history of eating ice cream, this is highly suggestive of Listeria monocytogenes. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
